# teleprompter.wtf

> Free online teleprompter with camera: record Reels, Shorts and YouTube videos in Studio, or use the classic presenter. No login or upload.

teleprompter.wtf is a free, open-source browser teleprompter and local video recorder. Studio records with the script beside the camera lens, stores takes on the device and exports through the browser. The classic presenter offers manual scrolling and mirroring. Product analytics use self-hosted Umami without user content.
